First public test candidate of the offline Street Fighter IV Champion Edition ARMv7 port for PS Vita.

## Included

- Vita loader, original Vita icon/LiveArea artwork and license notices.
- Native touch menus and physical combat controls, with the mobile combat overlay hidden.
- Native Cricket audio through Vita stereo output.
- Corrected packed-color texture uploads and adaptive combat camera.
- Optional interpolated combat drawing targeting 60 presentations/s while preserving the original ~20 Hz simulation.
- Original intro playback with audio and skip/return-to-title support; absent video is skipped automatically.
- Stable static main-menu background: the optional replay preview is disabled.

## Installation

1. Install kubridge, FdFix (unless using rePatch), and `libshacccg.suprx`.
2. Install `SF4CE.vpk` using VitaShell.
3. From your own ARMv7 Android 1.05.00 copy, place `libGltest2jni.so` and the matching `libc++_shared.so` in `ux0:data/sf4ce/`.
4. Place game assets in `ux0:data/sf4ce/assets/` and demand-loaded assets in `ux0:data/sf4ce/demand_assets/`.
5. Optionally add `demand_assets/sf4_online.mp4`. Without it, the title remains usable and does not fade into a missing intro.

**No APK, Android library, game data, game artwork, music or video is included.** The Vita shell graphics are original vector artwork supplied with the port.

## Controls and limitations

- Menus use touch. Combat uses the D-pad/left stick and face buttons; the in-game controls screen describes the original Android touch layout.
- Touch, Cross, Circle or Start skips the intro.
- Online battles, store and platform services are unavailable. Native offline menus are retained.
- Real Vita hardware validation is still pending: performance, memory use, audio latency and full stage/cinematic coverage are not certified.
- `smooth_rendering=1` targets 60 rendered presentations; simulation/animation poses retain their native cadence and interpolation adds up to one native tick of visual latency.
- Vita3K testing uses a local build with required compatibility changes, including ETC1/base-vertex support from [PR #3903](https://github.com/Vita3K/Vita3K/pull/3903). An additional local ETC1 byte-order fix is used for correct command-list backgrounds. Stock builds without this compatibility can fail or render incorrectly.

See the README for options and build instructions. `SHA256SUMS` verifies the VPK. Matching loader source and editable Vita graphics are included in the repository/tag source archive.
